_comment: SYNTHETIC DATA. Employer view built from Part 3's team_themes.json (fixed 5-theme rollup, banded severity/prevalence, no thresholds, no counts, no per-person magnitudes -- see the employer-view privacy redesign spec). No opt-in data exists in this pipeline by design — see opt_in_shares below.

opt_in_shares.suppressed_message: Opt-in sharing is not part of this pipeline — Part 3's privacy contract keeps individual insights out of Part 4 entirely, so nothing is ever escalated here.

never_shown: Any per-person biometric or calendar record
Counts of affected people below the k-anonymity threshold
Any ranking or comparison between team members

causal_categories.structural_fact: Days with 120+ minutes booked in meetings are followed by measurably higher strain.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Audit every recurring invite over 30 minutes and cancel or halve any that has no decision owner.

causal_categories.structural_fact: Days containing an unbroken meeting stretch of 60+ minutes are followed by measurably higher strain. Days leaving 480+ minutes of uninterrupted focus time are followed by measurably lower strain.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Switch the calendar default to 25- and 50-minute meetings so gaps exist without anyone having to ask for them.

causal_categories.structural_fact: No out-of-hours scheduling pattern reached the reporting threshold for this team.
causal_categories.recommended_action: No change needed. Keep working hours set on the shared calendar.

causal_categories.structural_fact: No meeting-hygiene pattern reached the reporting threshold for this team.
causal_categories.recommended_action: No change needed. Keep the current agenda expectation.

causal_categories.structural_fact: No midday-recovery pattern reached the reporting threshold for this team.
causal_categories.recommended_action: No change needed. Keep the midday break protected.
